episodes.synopsis: What begins as a vacation for our hero on Melemele Island in the Alola region turns into the promise of many, many exciting adventures to come!
episodes.title: Alola to New Adventure!

episodes.synopsis: Ash and Pikachu are adjusting to life in the Alola region-and it's about to give them a powerful push in a new direction!
episodes.title: The Guardian's Challenge!

episodes.synopsis: Ash's journey in the Alola region is just getting under way, and our hero has a new partner to share it with!
episodes.title: Loading the Dex!

episodes.synopsis: Ash is after his first Pokémon in the Alola region, and the adventure that ensues is typical Ash!
episodes.title: First Catch in Alola, Ketchum-Style!

episodes.synopsis: Ash's Pokémon class is off to the sea for some fishing, but Team Rocket has a completely different kind of fishing in mind!
episodes.title: Yo, Ho, Ho! Go, Popplio!

episodes.synopsis: Ash's first day off from Pokémon School was supposed to be a relaxing break, but things don't go quite as expected!
episodes.title: A Shocking Grocery Run!

episodes.synopsis: A feisty Litten is determined to steal food from others, and Ash and Pikachu are determined to find out why!
episodes.title: That's Why the Litten Is a Scamp!

episodes.synopsis: Lillie has a Pokémon Egg to care for until it hatches, but will fear get in her way?
episodes.title: Lillie's Egg-xhilarating Challenge!

episodes.synopsis: Ash wants a new Z-Crystal, but he must face some formidable tasks first!
episodes.title: To Top a Totem!

episodes.synopsis: The Melemele Island grand trial is imminent, and Ash must square off against the power and wisdom of Kahuna Hala!
episodes.title: Trial and Tribulation!

episodes.synopsis: Ash has time off from school for training, but a fellow student's activities away from school have our hero wanting to find out all about it!
episodes.title: Young Kiawe Had a Farm!

episodes.synopsis: While our heroes enjoy a class on the beach, familiar and unfamiliar troubles are brewing behind the scenes!
episodes.title: The Sun, the Scare, the Secret Lair!

episodes.synopsis: An Alolan tradition whets everyone’s appetite for fun, and Ash decides to join in!
episodes.title: Racing to a Big Event!

episodes.synopsis: The time has come for Lillie to address her fears, and having a new friend is the perfect way to do it!
episodes.title: Getting to Know You!

episodes.synopsis: Rockruff's current behavior may be a mystery, but Ash and Professor Kukui are determined to get to the bottom of it!
episodes.title: Rocking Clawmark Hill!

episodes.synopsis: Team Rocket has their eyes on our heroes' Pokémon, but a mysterious third Pokémon has a different idea!
episodes.title: They Might Not Be Giants!

episodes.synopsis: There's a mystery that needs solving, and there's also a surprising sleuth who's determined to solve it!
episodes.title: Crystal-Clear Sleuthing!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes are hungry indeed, but a quest to find the missing ingredient is keeping them that way!
episodes.title: A Seasoned Search!

episodes.synopsis: Ash is looking for a very important rematch, and his training regimen is breaking new ground!
episodes.title: A Guardian Rematch!

episodes.synopsis: A pleasant day trip for our heroes turns into an unforgettable adventure!
episodes.title: Partner Promises!

episodes.synopsis: The ending of one chapter in the life of a determined Pokémon ushers in the beginning of a brand-new one!
episodes.title: One Journey Ends, Another Begins...

episodes.synopsis: A day at the beach offers up our heroes much more than they bargained for!
episodes.title: A Shivering Shovel Search!

episodes.synopsis: A major force in Alolan popular music is in the verge of collapse!
episodes.title: Getting the Band Back Together!

episodes.synopsis: It's the Open House day at the Pokémon School, and a surprising group of people has gathered for all the fun!
episodes.title: Alolan Open House!

episodes.synopsis: There's a Z-Crystal ripe for the picking, but are the unlikely pickers up to the task?
episodes.title: A Team-on-Team Tussle!

episodes.synopsis: Moving to a new place and a new life can be stressful for anyone, and the Pokémon School gang is no exception!
episodes.title: So Long, Sophocles!

episodes.synopsis: A powerful Trainer has recently appeared on Melemele Island, and Ash can’t wait to find out everything about him!
episodes.title: A Glaring Rivalry!

episodes.synopsis: It’s Pokémon Base season in Alola, and the Pokémon School gang can’t seem to get enough of it: even playing against the enemy!
episodes.title: Pulling Out the Pokémon Base Pepper!

episodes.synopsis: A Pokémon School camping trip, complete with a scary campfire story, makes for an experience our heroes will never forget!
episodes.title: Lulled to La-La Land!

episodes.synopsis: An unusual assignment at the Pokémon School gives our heroes a surprising opportunity to learn, grow, and have fun at the same time!
episodes.title: The Ol' Raise and Switch!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes are preparing for a field trip on Akala Island, and the island kahuna promises to make it a trip to remember!
episodes.title: The Island Whisperer!

episodes.synopsis: It's a new day for the Pokémon School field trip, and our heroes are preparing for an adventure they will treasure forever!
episodes.title: Treasure Hunt, Akala Style!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes are busy with extracurricular activities on Akala Island, and Ash and Lana are in for a great adventure!
episodes.title: Big Sky, Small Fry!

episodes.synopsis: The Wela Fire Festival is just starting to heat up, but someone seems determined to put it out!
episodes.title: A Crowning Moment of Truth!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes are embarking on a mission filled with good taste...and a surprising finish!
episodes.title: Currying Favor and Flavor!

episodes.synopsis: The time for Ash's grand trial with Olivia is finally here, and it's no ordinary battle!
episodes.title: Trials and Determinations!

episodes.synopsis: As if Ash's victory at his grand trial wasn't monumental enough, an unexpected transformation makes a memorable field trip even more momentous!
episodes.title: Rising from the Ruins!

episodes.synopsis: When Mimikyu faces a fashion problem, Jessie sees a bonding opportunity!
episodes.title: Mimikyu Unmasked!

episodes.synopsis: It's a challenging day for Mallow and her family restaurant, and emotions are running high!
episodes.title: Mallow and the Forest Teacher!

episodes.synopsis: Lana and Popplio are working hard to master their Z-Move, but their progress is soon to grow by leaps and bounds!
episodes.title: Balloons, Brionne, and Belligerence!

episodes.synopsis: Three of our heroes are teaming up for the annual Charjabug race, an electrifying event with shocking results!
episodes.title: Mounting an Electrifying Charge!

episodes.synopsis: A celebratory Pokémon School class trip turns out to be a reunion no one will ever forget!
episodes.title: Alola, Kanto!

episodes.synopsis: The Cerulean Gym is the setting for old and new friends, battling old and new skills!
episodes.title: When Regions Collide!

episodes.synopsis: A vivid dream has set our hero on a mission to find out its true meaning!
episodes.title: A Dream Encounter!

episodes.synopsis: As our heroes get to know Nebby better, Nebby gets to know them better, too!
episodes.title: Now You See Them, Now You Don't!

episodes.synopsis: While our heroes explore one part of Aether Paradise, Team Rocket is busy exploring another!
episodes.title: Deceiving Appearances!

episodes.synopsis: Ash and his friends are off on another big adventure, thanks to Nebby's amazing powers!
episodes.title: A Masked Warning!

episodes.synopsis: A sleepover at Professor Kukui's house sets the stage for fun, friendship, and unexpected adventure!
episodes.title: Night of a Thousand Poses!

episodes.synopsis: Lillie is on a mission to put her past behind her once and for all!
episodes.title: Mission: Total Recall!

episodes.synopsis: Although Faba's original sinister plot has been foiled, he isn't about to give up on his dream!
episodes.title: Faba's Revenge!

episodes.synopsis: Lusamine has been captured by an Ultra Beast and swept away through an Ultra Wormhole, but everyone is determined to get her back safely!
episodes.title: Family Determination!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes are determined to rescue Lusamine, and help is coming from unexpected and astounding sources!
episodes.title: Revealing the Stuff of Legend!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes are determined to rescue Lusamine from inside the Ultra Wormhole, but Lusamine has other ideas!
episodes.title: Rescuing the Unwilling!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes are doing everything they can to save Lusamine from an Ultra Beast...while Lusamine is doing everything she can to stop them!
episodes.title: 10,000,000 Reasons to Fight!

episodes.synopsis: Professors Kukui and Burnet are getting married, and our heroes know just what to do to help!
episodes.title: The Professors' New Adventure!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes are wondering about Komala's sleep patterns when they're interrupted by a familiar visitor!
episodes.title: Let Sleeping Pokémon Lie!

episodes.synopsis: Rotom Dex embarks on an electrifying journey-whether it wants to or not!
episodes.title: The Dex Can't Help It!

episodes.synopsis: n accidental encounter with the past puts the present and future in jeopardy!
episodes.title: Fighting Back the Tears!

episodes.synopsis: A distant memory shared by Mallow and Lana is rekindled in a bittersweet way!
episodes.title: Tasting the Bitter with the Sweet!

episodes.synopsis: A trip to Mount Lanakila gives our heroes the opportunity to learn and grow in ways they hadn't imagined!
episodes.title: Getting a Jump on the Competition!

episodes.synopsis: The appearance of another Ultra Beast compels our heroes to take on new roles-and take charge!
episodes.title: A Mission of Ultra Urgency!

episodes.synopsis: An unexpected appearance by a cunning visitor is turning Team Rocket's world on its head!
episodes.title: Acting True to Form!

episodes.synopsis: The appearance of a popular Alolan battling duo brings out some surprising fiery determination!
episodes.title: Pushing the Fiery Envelope!

episodes.synopsis: Ash takes a trip to the marketplace and meets the local group of Passimians, who have a rivalry with the Akala Island Passimians.
episodes.title: Satoshi and Nagetukesaru! Touchdown of Friendship!!

episodes.synopsis: A visit by a surprise Pokémon School graduate dazzles our heroes with the stuff of legends!
episodes.title: Turning Heads and Training Hard!

episodes.synopsis: Pokémon School graduate Ilima teaches our heroes about an activity that's near and dear to his heart!
episodes.title: Smashing with Sketch!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes are about to welcome an unexpected addition into the family-unexpected in so many delightful ways!
episodes.title: Love at First Twirl!

episodes.synopsis: Nurse Joy is feeling a bit under the weather today, but we know just the heroes to help her out!
episodes.title: Real Life...Inquire Within!

episodes.synopsis: A potential disaster threatens the future of the Alola region, but the Ultra Guardians are ready, willing, and able to deal with it!
episodes.title: Rise and Shine, Starship!

episodes.synopsis: The survival of Kiawe's family farm may be at stake, but our heroes are up to the challenge!
episodes.title: The Young Flame Strikes Back!

episodes.synopsis: There are lots of interesting Pokémon for our heroes to discover in Alola, and the one they meet today is no exception!
episodes.title: Dewpider Ascending!

episodes.synopsis: There's a big baking competition coming up in Alola, and a surprising participant is joining in on the fun!
episodes.title: Sours for the Sweet!

episodes.synopsis: Team Rocket appears to be stuck in a rut, but solutions can come from high places!
episodes.title: Why Not Give Me a Z-Ring Sometime?

episodes.synopsis: A series of smaller trials line the pathway to Ash's goal-a grand trial!
episodes.title: Tough Guy Trials!

episodes.synopsis: Ash is determined to train with Tapu Bulu, and Tapu Bulu is determined to be as unpredictable as ever!
episodes.title: Some Kind of Laziness!

episodes.synopsis: Ash and Pikachu are all set for their pre-trial rematch against the island kahuna, but Nanu has a different idea!
episodes.title: A Battle Hand-Off!

episodes.synopsis: Ash's grand trial on Ula'ula Island is in full swing, and the kahuna has lots of twists and turns in store for the battle!
episodes.title: Guiding an Awakening!

episodes.synopsis: The Ultra Guardians are being called upon again, but this time, they're on double duty!
episodes.title: Twirling with a Bang!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes are stargazing, little suspecting the spectacle that awaits them in the night sky!
episodes.title: Showering the World with Love!

episodes.synopsis: A surprising show of determination leads to a happy outcome for many-in many different ways!
episodes.title: Not Caving Under Pressure!

episodes.synopsis: The Battle Royal Dome is ablaze with battling excitement, but this time the Masked Royal has a little help!
episodes.title: A Young Royal Flame Ignites!

episodes.synopsis: A rousing Pokémon School class project has everyone out of their chairs, and out on the floor!
episodes.title: All They Want to Do Is Dance, Dance!

episodes.synopsis: When Faba appoints himself professor for the day at the Pokémon School, an unexpected event shows that big adventures can come in small packages!
episodes.title: Dummy, You Shrunk the Kids!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes have met an astoundingly talented artist, but there's much more to her and her partner than meets the eye!
episodes.title: The Shape of Love to Come!

episodes.synopsis: Another Ultra Beast has made its way to Alola, and the Ultra Guardians have an ultra-gigantic mission on their hands!
episodes.title: The Long Vault Home!

episodes.synopsis: Everybody's looking forward to a relaxing day at a health spa, although a few secretly have different plans!
episodes.title: I Choose Paradise!

episodes.synopsis: Things are not right in Alola, and our heroes are poised to find out why!
episodes.title: Filling the Light with Darkness!

episodes.synopsis: A mysterious creature has emerged from an Ultra Wormhole and now appears to be threatening Alola, but our heroes are ready to do anything they can to help!
episodes.title: Full Moon and Many Arms!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes are on a mission to rescue Solgaleo from UB Black's clutches, and what a mission it is turning out to be!
episodes.title: The Prism Between Light and Darkness!

episodes.synopsis: The Ultra Guardians are on a mission to save Poipole's world, and everyone and everything depends on them!
episodes.title: Securing the Future!

episodes.synopsis: The rumors are true, and our heroes can't pika-believe what they find!
episodes.title: A Plethora of Pikachu!

episodes.synopsis: It's time for the Masked Royal to face his old rival in the ring, but first, there are a few obstacles to be dealt with!
episodes.title: Turning the Other Mask!

episodes.synopsis: The Pokémon School class is putting on a play with more twists and turns than they could ever expect!
episodes.title: Lillier and the Staff!

episodes.synopsis: Harper and Sarah are excited to visit a haunted house, and they end up having a bit too much fun!
episodes.title: A Haunted House for Everyone!

episodes.synopsis: Some unusual activity is occurring around Wela Volcano, but the Ultra Guardians are on the case!
episodes.title: Sparking Confusion!

episodes.synopsis: While Ash runs an errand to Aether Paradise, a certain trio of troublemakers sets out to catch Pokémon there!
episodes.title: Don't Ignore the Small Stufful!

episodes.synopsis: A chance meeting with another Trainer gives Ash and Rowlet new battle experiences they never imagined!
episodes.title: No Stone Unturned!

episodes.synopsis: Rotom Dex's love of the hit TV show Alolan Detective Laki produces some unexpected results!
episodes.title: Bright Lights, Big Changes!

episodes.synopsis: An ocean-loving Eevee has traveled many miles…and where one journey ends, another is about to begin!
episodes.title: We Know Where You're Going, Eevee!

episodes.synopsis: A spur-of-the-moment battle with Tapu Koko results in an unexpected, unbelievable journey for Ash and Pikachu!
episodes.title: Battling the Beast Within!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes are grappling with an Alola region in a parallel world-and they've appeared just in time to help save it!
episodes.title: Parallel Friendships!

episodes.synopsis: At the start of their break, the Pokémon School students have visitors-and Ash can't believe his eyes!
episodes.title: Alola, Alola!

episodes.synopsis: Brock and Misty continue to enjoy their Alola region vacation, but there are some who would like that to stop!
episodes.title: Heart of Fire, Heart of Stone!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes are visiting Poni Island for their school research projects, but they're not the only ones with big plans!
episodes.title: That's Some Spicy Island Research!

episodes.synopsis: Ash's research project is all about battling, but who will that battling involve?
episodes.title: Showdown on Poni Island!

episodes.synopsis: As the Pokémon School class continues their research projects on Poni Island, Sophocles and Lana have some big surprises in store!
episodes.title: Evolving Research!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes' research projects continue on Poni Island, and now is the time for Kiawe and Mallow to shine!
episodes.title: Run, Heroes, Run!

episodes.synopsis: A visit to Hapu's farm envelops our heroes in an experience they will never forget!
episodes.title: Memories in the Mist!

episodes.synopsis: The Pokémon School students have one more research project to complete, and it's sure to generate excitement and electricity for everyone!
episodes.title: A Grand Debut!

episodes.synopsis: When the Pokémon School class meets an accomplished Pokémon Golfer, they learn some valuable lessons and have fun at the same time!
episodes.title: Keeping Your Eyes on the Ball!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes have made an incredible discovery, and they're just beginning to digest the details!
episodes.title: Show Me the Metal!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes have discovered a new species of Pokémon named Meltan, and one Meltan in particular has discovered a new friend!
episodes.title: Got Meltan?

episodes.synopsis: An appearance on a TV quiz show leads our heroes into a world they only dreamed of!
episodes.title: This Magik Moment!

episodes.synopsis: Alola is facing another crisis, and the Ultra Guardians are facing a double shift!
episodes.title: Beauty Is Only Crystal Deep!

episodes.synopsis: Professor Kukui's big announcement is making unexpected waves with unexpected people!
episodes.title: The Dealer of Destruction!

episodes.synopsis: An emotional look into the past reveals astounding people and places, and nothing will ever be the same again!
episodes.title: The Secret Princess!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes' visit to a popular tourist attraction ends up being anything but a breeze!
episodes.title: Drawn with the Wind!

episodes.synopsis: A second day in Malie City provides our heroes with a hard-earned chance for some unexpected excitement!
episodes.title: Aiming for the Top Floor!

episodes.synopsis: Sophocles may be excited to compete in a favorite race, but winning is about much more than coming in first!
episodes.title: A High-Speed Awakening!

episodes.synopsis: What starts as an ordinary fishing expedition turns into a much bigger adventure than anyone could have imagined!
episodes.title: The One That Didn't Get Away!

episodes.synopsis: When Mallow sets out on a routine errand, little does she know she'll return with much more than she ever dreamed of!
episodes.title: A Recipe for Success!

episodes.synopsis: One of Team Rocket's questionable claims comes back to haunt them when they're paid a visit by Giovanni's assistant Matori!
episodes.title: Spying for the Big Guy!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes can't wait to start training for the upcoming Alola Pokémon League, but not everyone is feeling confident!
episodes.title: A Fiery Training Camp Trick!

episodes.synopsis: Objects are being cut into pieces all over Melemele Island, and the Ultra Guardians set out to investigate!
episodes.title: Living on the Cutting Edge!

episodes.synopsis: An unexpected encounter with an unexpected Pokémon takes Ash on an adventure he'll never forget!
episodes.title: A Timeless Encounter!

episodes.synopsis: While Ash was caught up in an untimely adventure, his Pokémon were having quite an adventure of their own!
episodes.title: Pikachu's Exciting Adventure!

episodes.synopsis: The Alola Pokémon League is off to a rousing start, and emotions are running high in and out of Manalo Stadium!
episodes.title: Chasing Memories, Creating Dreams!

episodes.synopsis: The Alola Pokémon League is gearing up for a thrilling opening, but there seems to be trouble ahead.
episodes.title: League Offenders and Defenders!

episodes.synopsis: The Alola Pokémon League is off to a rousing start with a Battle Royal competition among friends and rivals both old and new!
episodes.title: Battle Royale 151!

episodes.synopsis: As the Alola Pokémon League marches on, friends and rivals alike give it their all!
episodes.title: Battling Besties!

episodes.synopsis: The Alola Pokémon League is in full swing, and there's no shortage of surprises in store!
episodes.title: The Battlefield of Truth and Love!

episodes.synopsis: As Ash and Rowlet prepare for their battle against Hau in the Alola Pokémon League, they get a little help from some old friends!
episodes.title: Imitation Is the Sincerest Form of Strategy!

episodes.synopsis: As the Alola Pokémon League quarterfinals continue, Ash and Rowlet's battle against Hau and Decidueye takes plenty of twists and turns!
episodes.title: Battling on the Wing!

episodes.synopsis: The Alola Pokémon League quarterfinals are wrapping up, and today's event promises to be a wild ride!
episodes.title: The Road to the Semifinals!

episodes.synopsis: The first match of the Alola Pokémon League semifinals is up next, and the final four Trainers are determined to come out on top!
episodes.title: The Final Four!

episodes.synopsis: As the Alola Pokémon League nears the finals, the stakes are getting higher, and temperatures are rising to a fever pitch!
episodes.title: Getting Down to the Ire!

episodes.synopsis: The second round of the Alola Pokémon League semifinals is proceeding at a rapid pace, and there's a lot more going on than meets the eye!
episodes.title: The Wisdom Not to Run!

episodes.synopsis: It's time for the Alola Pokémon League finals, and the competitors are more determined than ever to become Champion!
episodes.title: Final Rivals!

episodes.synopsis: The Alola Pokémon League is down to the final moments of the final battle! Who will emerge victorious?
episodes.title: Enter the Champion!

episodes.synopsis: Although the Alola Pokémon League is over, a new type of excitement is just beginning!
episodes.title: Z-Move Showdown!

episodes.synopsis: The Alola Pokémon League's exhibition match is off to a fiery start-just as expected for a battle between Ash and the now-unmasked Masked Royal!
episodes.title: Exhibition Unmasked!

episodes.synopsis: In the air or on the ground, the Alola Pokémon League's exhibition match between Ash and Professor Kukui is roaring along!
episodes.title: A Full Battle Bounty!

episodes.synopsis: The exhibition match between Ash and Professor Kukui continues with a long-awaited fiery showdown!
episodes.title: Fiery Surprises!

episodes.synopsis: Ash's win at the Alola Pokémon League was astounding-but the resulting exhibition match has some colossal surprises in store, too!
episodes.title: From Z to Shining Z!

episodes.synopsis: Now that the Alola Pokémon League is over, it's time for the Pokémon School class to make plans for their upcoming vacation!
episodes.title: Dreaming of the Sun and Moon!

episodes.synopsis: With their big vacation on the horizon, our heroes are setting some life-changing plans into motion!
episodes.title: Thank You, Alola! The Journey Continues!
